title: Case 001: The Door Is Real
tests: Whether proof can protect a person without capturing them.
summary: Determine whether Mara Vale truly returned, then decide what kind of truth can survive visibility.

witnesses.Publish: Rafi distrusts your speed. Public witnesses multiply.
witnesses.Bury: Elian remains protected. Public record decays.
witnesses.Preserve: Mara's absence remains intact. The Archive gains a careful proof.

Publish.name: Rafi Kline
Publish.note: Rafi believes the exposure weakened the counterfeit but moved faster than care.
Publish.lead: May provide public thread archives, but withholds private witness material.

Bury.name: Elian Vale
Bury.note: Elian remains out of public view because the Archive did not expose Mara's route.
Bury.lead: May pass future off-record warnings through trusted intermediaries.

Preserve.name: Mara Vale
Preserve.note: Mara is not contacted, exposed, or proven. Her absence remains intact.
Preserve.lead: Her preserved contradiction points toward synthetic continuity patterns.

vault.Publish: Public reconstruction of the False Returned
vault.Bury: Sealed note on Mara's protected absence

Publish.title: Public reconstruction of the False Returned
Publish.why: It weakens the counterfeit but turns Mara's exit into a public object.

Bury.title: Sealed note on Mara's protected absence
Bury.why: It protects Mara but leaves the public falsehood largely intact.

Preserve.title: Preserved Mara Vale reconstruction
Preserve.why: It keeps the contradiction findable without making Mara's exit a destination.

Publish.lead: A witness offers a leak because exposure made them afraid of being next.

Bury.lead: A Returned contact opens a quieter channel because you showed restraint.

Preserve.lead: The Archive detects a pattern between Mara's case and synthetic community continuity.

Publish.label: Broadcast Scar
Publish.text: Your public reconstruction of Mara changes how Harbor Dawn reaches you. The first leak arrives fast, but the witness asks whether the Archive can slow down once people are already looking.

Bury.label: Hidden Scar
Bury.text: Because you protected Mara's route, Harbor Dawn does not arrive as a leak. It arrives as a private warning from someone who thinks survivor memory should not be corrected in public.

Preserve.label: Living Scar
Preserve.text: The preserved Mara reconstruction lets the Archive detect a quieter pattern: synthetic continuity did not only imitate a person. It helped build a community.
